note: Seth Ji ke Case - reasoning cases in the style of GMAT critical reasoning (founder, 15 Nov): four answers that all look right, one that survives careful thought. Each clue is a fact about one answer (clue i belongs to option i). The founder approves each case (approved: true) before it is played live. 'answer' is the correct option's text. Medical and aviation cases are famous moments from history, told as stories - never advice.

cases.title: Saalim Taala
cases.brief: Jeweller ki dukaan se raat ko zewar chori hue. Taala toota nahi aur alarm nahi baja. Sub-inspector kehta hai: 'Taala saalim hai, is liye chor zaroor dukaan ka koi mulazim hai - chaabi sirf teen mulazimon ke paas hoti hai.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat sub-inspector ke nateeje ko sab se zyada kamzor karti hai?
options: Pichle mahine taala badalne wala karigar ek zaaid chaabi apne paas rakh gaya tha.
Teeno mulazimon ke ghar walon ne tasdeeq ki ke woh us raat ghar pe the.
Dukaan ka alarm pichle ek hafte se kharab para tha.
Chori hue zewar ki qeemat mulazimon ki kai saalon ki tankhwah se zyada thi.
cases.answer: Pichle mahine taala badalne wala karigar ek zaaid chaabi apne paas rakh gaya tha.

clues.label: Taale ka karigar
clues.text: Karigar ne maana ke us ne ek zaaid chaabi banayi thi. Woh dukaan ka mulazim nahi hai.

clues.label: Ghar walon ki gawahi
clues.text: Ghar wale apnon ke haq mein hi bolte hain. Aur ghar pe hone se yeh sabit nahi hota ke chaabi kisi aur ko nahi di gayi.

clues.label: Alarm ki report
clues.text: Kharab alarm sirf yeh batata hai ke ghanti kyun nahi baji. Taala kaise khula, is ka jawab is mein nahi.

clues.label: Zewar ki qeemat
clues.text: Itni bari raqam toh mulazimon ke liye lalach ki wajah banti hai - is se un pe shak barhta hai.

cases.explain: Nateeja is pe khara hai ke chaabi sirf mulazimon ke paas thi. Zaaid chaabi yeh buniyad hi gira deti hai. Ghar walon ki gawahi aur kharab alarm taale ka sawal hal nahi karte.

cases.title: Gumshuda Haar
cases.brief: Shadi ke ghar mein dulhan ka haar 3 baje ghaib paya gaya. Bijli 2 se 3 baje tak band thi. Mehmanon ke mutabiq us ek ghante mein kamre ke andar sirf darzan gayi. Inspector: 'Is liye haar darzan ne churaya.'
cases.question: Inspector ki daleel kis baat ko maan ke chal rahi hai (jo kahi nahi gayi)?
options: Haar 2 baje, bijli jane ke waqt, kamre mein maujood tha.
Kamre mein jane ka sirf ek hi darwaza hai.
Darzan ko paison ki sakht zaroorat thi.
Bijli kisi ne jaan boojh ke band ki thi.
cases.answer: Haar 2 baje, bijli jane ke waqt, kamre mein maujood tha.

clues.label: Haar kab dekha gaya
clues.text: Haar ko aakhri dafa subah 11 baje dekha gaya tha. 11 se 2 baje ke beech kamre mein kai log aate jate rahe.

clues.label: Kamre ke darwaze
clues.text: Kamre ke do darwaze hain, magar dono ke saamne mehman baithe the - sab kehte hain sirf darzan andar gayi.

clues.label: Darzan ka haal
clues.text: Darzan khush-haal hai. Magar daleel ne us ki zaroorat ka zikr hi nahi kiya - sirf mauqe ka kiya hai.

clues.label: Bijli ka masla
clues.text: Bijli poore mohalle ki gayi thi. Daleel ko is se farq nahi parta ke bijli kyun gayi.

cases.explain: Daleel tabhi chalti hai jab haar 2 baje tak wahin ho. Agar pehle hi ja chuka tha toh darzan be-qasoor hai. Darwazon wali baat ki zaroorat nahi - mehman pehle hi keh chuke ke sirf darzan gayi.

cases.title: Jahaz ki Beemari
cases.brief: Saal 1747. Lambe samandari safar pe mallahon ke masoorhon se khoon aa raha hai aur zakhm nahi bhar rahe. Jahaz ke doctor James Lind ka khayal hai: 'Yeh beemari taza phalon ki kami se hoti hai.'
cases.question: Kaunsa mushahida doctor ke khayal ko sab se zyada mazboot karta hai?
options: Jin 2 mallahon ko roz malte mile woh theek ho gaye; baqi, wohi khana kha ke, beemar rahe.
Afsar, jin ka khana behtar hota hai, mallahon se kam beemar parte hain.
Bandargah pohanch ke aksar mallah chand din mein theek ho jate hain.
Yeh beemari sirf lambe safar mein hoti hai, chhote safar mein nahi.
cases.answer: Jin 2 mallahon ko roz malte mile woh theek ho gaye; baqi, wohi khana kha ke, beemar rahe.

clues.label: Malton ka tajurba
clues.text: Sab beemar ek hi jagah, ek hi khane pe the. Farq sirf itna tha ke do ko roz malte mile - aur sirf wohi theek hue.

clues.label: Afsaron ki zindagi
clues.text: Afsaron ke paas taza gosht, sukha bistar aur kam mehnat bhi hai. Farq kis cheez se para, yeh pata nahi chalta.

clues.label: Bandargah ka asar
clues.text: Bandargah pe aaram, saaf paani aur taza khana - sab ek saath milta hai. Kaunsi cheez ne theek kiya?

clues.label: Lamba safar
clues.text: Lambe safar mein thakan, nami aur purana paani - bohat kuch badal jata hai, sirf phal nahi.

cases.explain: Sirf malton wale tajurbe mein baqi sab kuch barabar tha aur ek hi cheez badli. Afsar, bandargah aur lamba safar - teeno mein kai cheezein ek saath badalti hain. Yeh tareekh ka pehla mashhoor medical tajurba mana jata hai.

cases.title: London ka Nalka
cases.brief: Saal 1854, London ka Soho mohalla - haize se sainkron mautein. Sarkari doctor: 'Beemari gandi hawa se phailti hai; dekho, mautein badbu wale mohallon mein hi hain.' Dr John Snow ko shak hai ke wajah paani hai.
cases.question: Kaunsi baat 'gandi hawa' wale nazariye ko sab se zyada kamzor karti hai?
options: Usi badbu-daar gali ke karkhane ke 70 mazdoor, jo apne kuein ka paani peete hain, sab theek hain.
Zyada tar mautein Broad Street ke nalke ke qareeb ke gharon mein hui hain.
Jin ameer mohallon mein badbu kam hai, wahan mautein bhi kam hain.
Nalke ka paani dekhne mein bilkul saaf aur chamakdar hai.
cases.answer: Usi badbu-daar gali ke karkhane ke 70 mazdoor, jo apne kuein ka paani peete hain, sab theek hain.

clues.label: Karkhane ke mazdoor
clues.text: Mazdoor din bhar wohi hawa saans mein lete hain jo baqi gali leti hai. Farq sirf un ke paani ka hai.

clues.label: Mauton ka naqsha
clues.text: Nalke ke paas rehne wale wohi badbu-daar hawa bhi saans mein lete hain. Yeh baat dono nazariyon se mel khati hai.

clues.label: Ameer mohalle
clues.text: Kam badbu, kam mautein - yeh toh 'gandi hawa' wale nazariye ki himayat karta hai.

clues.label: Paani ki shakal
clues.text: Saaf nazar aane wala paani logon ka shak paani se hata deta hai - hawa wale nazariye ko nuqsan nahi deta.

cases.explain: Mazdoor wohi hawa lete the magar paani alag peete the - aur bach gaye. Nalke ke qareeb mautein hawa se bhi samjhayi ja sakti hain, is liye woh hawa ke nazariye ko nahi girati. Dr Snow ne nalka band karwaya aur wabaa ruk gayi.

cases.title: Chashm-deed Gawah
cases.brief: Gawah: 'Main ne raat 11 baje mulzim ko dukaan se nikalte dekha.' Sarkari wakeel: 'Gawah ki mulzim se koi dushmani nahi, usay jhoot bolne ka koi faida nahi. Is liye us ki gawahi durust hai.' Aap mulzim ke wakeel hain.
cases.question: Sarkari wakeel ki daleel mein sab se bari kamzori kya hai?
options: Dushmani na ho toh jhoot ka shak hat'ta hai - ghalat pehchan ka nahi.
Sirf ek gawah ki gawahi pe kisi ko saza nahi di ja sakti.
Mulzim kehta hai ke woh us waqt apne ghar pe tha.
Ho sakta hai gawah ki mulzim se koi chhupi hui dushmani ho.
cases.answer: Dushmani na ho toh jhoot ka shak hat'ta hai - ghalat pehchan ka nahi.

clues.label: Sach aur sahi ka farq
clues.text: Imandaar gawah bhi ghalti kar sakta hai: raat ka waqt, door ka faasla, chand second ki jhalak.

clues.label: Ek gawah ka qanoon
clues.text: Qanoon mein ek qabil-e-bharosa gawah ki gawahi bhi kaafi ho sakti hai. Yeh daleel ki kamzori nahi.

clues.label: Mulzim ka bayan
clues.text: Mulzim ka inkaar ek alag baat hai. Is se yeh pata nahi chalta ke wakeel ki daleel mein ghalti kahan hai.

clues.label: Chhupi dushmani
clues.text: Yeh sirf qiyas hai, is ka koi saboot nahi. Aur daleel mein is se bari kamzori maujood hai.

cases.explain: Wakeel ne 'jhoot nahi bol raha' ko 'ghalti nahi kar raha' samajh liya. Imandaar aadmi bhi andhere mein ghalat pehchan sakta hai. Chhupi dushmani sirf andaza hai - asal kamzori daleel ke andar hai.

cases.title: Wasiyat ka Kaghaz
cases.brief: Wasiyat pe tareekh 14 August 1995 likhi hai; sari jaidad naukar ke naam. Lab ki report: kaghaz us mill ka hai jo 2003 mein khuli; siyahi 1990 se bazaar mein hai; dastakhat Seth sahab ke asli dastakhat se milta hai.
cases.question: In haqaiq se kaunsa nateeja yaqeeni taur pe nikalta hai?
options: Yeh kaghaz 14 August 1995 ko likha hi nahi ja sakta tha.
Dastakhat naqli hai.
Yeh wasiyat naukar ne khud tayyar ki.
Seth sahab apni jaidad naukar ko nahi dena chahte the.
cases.answer: Yeh kaghaz 14 August 1995 ko likha hi nahi ja sakta tha.

clues.label: Kaghaz ki mill
clues.text: Mill ka record: pehla kaghaz March 2003 mein bana. Is se pehle yeh kaghaz duniya mein tha hi nahi.

clues.label: Dastakhat ka maahir
clues.text: Maahir kehta hai dastakhat asli bhi ho sakta hai - mumkin hai Seth sahab se baad mein karwaya gaya ho.

clues.label: Kis ne likhi
clues.text: Lab yeh nahi bata sakti ke kaghaz kis ne tayyar kiya. Faida kis ko hai, yeh saboot nahi hota.

clues.label: Seth sahab ki niyat
clues.text: Seth sahab zindagi mein naukar ki tareef karte the. Un ki niyat ka in haqaiq se kuch pata nahi chalta.

cases.explain: Haqaiq sirf itna sabit karte hain ke tareekh ghalat hai - 1995 mein yeh kaghaz bana hi nahi tha. Dastakhat asli ho sakta hai, likhne wala koi bhi ho sakta hai. Baqi teeno jawab haqaiq se aage nikal jate hain.

cases.title: Aakhri Over
cases.brief: Final ka aakhri over, mukhalif ko 8 run chahiye, crease pe Zaheer hai. Coach ka mashwara: 'Gend spinner Imad ko do. Aaj us ne 3 over mein sirf 12 run diye - woh hamara sab se kifayati bowler raha.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat coach ke mashware ko sab se zyada kamzor karti hai?
options: Imad ke teeno over tab hue jab Zaheer crease pe nahi tha; Zaheer spin ko khoob maarta hai.
Aakhri over mein bowler pe dabao bohat zyada hota hai.
Tez bowler Hassan ne aaj 2 wicket li hain.
Imad ne pichle match ke aakhri over mein 15 run diye the.
cases.answer: Imad ke teeno over tab hue jab Zaheer crease pe nahi tha; Zaheer spin ko khoob maarta hai.

clues.label: Imad ke over
clues.text: Scorecard: Imad ne apne teeno over doosre batsmen ko kiye. Zaheer ka spin ke khilaf strike rate 190 hai.

clues.label: Dabao
clues.text: Dabao har bowler pe barabar hoga - Imad pe bhi, kisi aur pe bhi. Is se chunao nahi badalta.

clues.label: Hassan ka din
clues.text: Hassan achha khela - magar is se yeh sabit nahi hota ke Imad ke 12 run wali daleel ghalat hai.

clues.label: Pichla match
clues.text: Woh ek hi over tha - alag pitch, alag batsman. Ek misaal se kuch sabit nahi hota.

cases.explain: Coach ki daleel '12 run' pe khari hai. Magar woh run un batsmen ke khilaf the jo Zaheer nahi the - yaani yeh hisaab aaj ke aakhri over pe laagu hi nahi hota. Pichle match ka ek over sirf ek misaal hai.

cases.title: Toss ka Faisla
cases.brief: Semi-final ka toss aap jeet gaye. Aap ke naib kaptaan: 'Is maidan pe pichle 10 match mein 8 dafa baad mein batting karne wali team jeeti. Is liye pehle bowling karenge toh hamare jeetne ka imkaan zyada hai.'
cases.question: Yeh daleel kis baat ko maan ke chal rahi hai (jo kahi nahi gayi)?
options: Woh 8 teamein baad mein batting ki wajah se jeetin - waise hi zyada mazboot nahi thin.
Aaj raat maidan pe os zaroor giregi.
Hamari bowling hamari batting se behtar hai.
Mukhalif team bara score banane ke baad dabao mein aa jati hai.
cases.answer: Woh 8 teamein baad mein batting ki wajah se jeetin - waise hi zyada mazboot nahi thin.

clues.label: Un 8 match ki teamein
clues.text: Un 8 mein se 6 match mein baad mein batting karne wali team ranking mein bhi kahin upar thi.

clues.label: Aaj ka mausam
clues.text: Daleel ne os ka zikr hi nahi kiya - woh sirf pichle 10 match ke record pe khari hai.

clues.label: Hamari team
clues.text: Daleel hamari team ki taaqat pe nahi, maidan ke record pe mabni hai. Is ke baghair bhi daleel wohi rehti hai.

clues.label: Mukhalif team
clues.text: Mukhalif team ke mizaaj ka daleel se koi taalluq nahi - record har team ka mila-jula hai.

cases.explain: Record tabhi kaam ka hai jab jeet ki wajah 'baad mein batting' ho. Agar woh teamein waise hi behtar thin toh record kuch nahi batata. Os ek wajah ho sakti hai, magar daleel us pe khari nahi.

cases.title: Darya ya Runway
cases.brief: January 2009: udaan ke 2 minute baad parinde takraye, dono engine band. Captain ne jahaz Hudson darya pe utaara; 155 log bach gaye. Baad mein tehqiqati committee: 'Captain ka faisla ghalat tha - simulator mein pilot wapis airport pohanch gaye the.'
cases.question: Aap Captain hain. Kaunsi baat committee ke nateeje ko sab se zyada kamzor karti hai?
options: Simulator ke pilot pehle se tayyar the; asal mein surat-e-haal samajhne mein 35 second lage.
Darya pe utarna bhi bohat khatarnak tha - paani barf jaisa thanda tha.
Jahaz mein 155 log sawar the, is liye khatra mol nahi liya ja sakta tha.
Captain ke paas 40 saal ka tajurba tha.
cases.answer: Simulator ke pilot pehle se tayyar the; asal mein surat-e-haal samajhne mein 35 second lage.

clues.label: Simulator ka tareeqa
clues.text: Simulator mein pilot ko pehle bata diya gaya tha ke kya hoga - us ne takkar ke fauran baad jahaz mor liya. 35 second ki der daali gayi toh har koshish nakaam hui.

clues.label: Darya ka khatra
clues.text: Darya ka khatra toh committee ki baat ko mazboot karta hai ke airport behtar hota.

clues.label: 155 zindagiyan
clues.text: Zyada log hon toh sahi faisla aur zaroori ho jata hai - magar is se yeh pata nahi chalta ke sahi faisla kaunsa tha.

clues.label: Captain ka tajurba
clues.text: Tajurba-kaar pilot bhi ghalti kar sakta hai. Committee ne tajurbe pe nahi, simulator ke nateeje pe baat ki hai.

cases.explain: Committee ki poori daleel simulator pe khari hai - aur simulator asal haalaat jaisa nahi tha. Jab us mein 35 second ki insani der shamil ki gayi toh jahaz airport nahi pohanch saka. Yeh asal waqia hai: 'Miracle on the Hudson'.

cases.title: Tel Khatam
cases.brief: 1983: ek jahaz ka tel beech hawa mein khatam ho gaya. Tel ka meter kharab tha, is liye amle ne haath se hisaab lagaya - aur litre ko kilo ki bajaye pound ke hisaab se zarb de di. Airline: 'Qasoor sirf amle ka hai; hisaab unhon ne ghalat kiya.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat airline ke daawe ko sab se zyada kamzor karti hai?
options: Airline ne usi mahine pound ki jagah kilo ka nizam shuru kiya aur amle ko tarbiyat nahi di.
Hisaab do logon ne mil ke lagaya tha, ek ne nahi.
Pilot ne baghair engine ke jahaz ko mehfooz utaar liya.
Jahazon mein tel ka meter kharab hona koi anokhi baat nahi.
cases.answer: Airline ne usi mahine pound ki jagah kilo ka nizam shuru kiya aur amle ko tarbiyat nahi di.

clues.label: Naya nizam
clues.text: Yeh airline ka pehla jahaz tha jo kilo pe chalta tha. Amle ko naye hisaab ki koi tarbiyat nahi mili thi.

clues.label: Kis ne hisaab kiya
clues.text: Do log hon ya ek - dono amle ke hi log the. Is se qasoor amle se bahar nahi jata.

clues.label: Mehfooz landing
clues.text: Landing ka kamaal baad ki baat hai. Is se yeh tay nahi hota ke tel ki ghalti kis ki thi.

clues.label: Meter ki kharabi
clues.text: Agar meter aksar kharab hote hain toh amle ko haath ka hisaab aana chahiye - yeh toh amle ke khilaf jata hai.

cases.explain: Agar airline ne nizam badla aur tarbiyat nahi di, toh ghalti 'sirf amle ki' nahi rehti - nizam ki bhi hai. Baqi baatein qasoor ko amle se bahar nahi le jatin. Yeh asal waqia hai: 'Gimli Glider', sab log bach gaye.

cases.title: Imarat mein Aag
cases.brief: Paanch manzila imarat ki teesri manzil pe aag hai; chauthi manzil pe 6 log phanse hain. Naya officer: 'Sab ko fauran seerhiyon se neeche bhejo. Seerhiyan pakki hain aur aag abhi wahan nahi pohanchi - yeh sab se mehfooz raasta hai.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat is hukm mein sab se bara khatra zahir karti hai?
options: Aag mein zyada mautein dhuein se hoti hain, aur dhuan seerhiyon se hi upar charhta hai.
Seerhiyan tang hain; 6 log ek saath nahi utar sakte.
Phanse hue logon mein ek buzurg hain jo aahista chalte hain.
Imarat ki lift band ho chuki hai.
cases.answer: Aag mein zyada mautein dhuein se hoti hain, aur dhuan seerhiyon se hi upar charhta hai.

clues.label: Dhuan
clues.text: Garam dhuan seerhiyon ko chimney ki tarah istemal karta hai. Do-teen saans mein insaan behosh ho sakta hai.

clues.label: Seerhiyon ki chaurai
clues.text: Tang seerhi se log ek ek kar ke, zara der se utrenge. Yeh der hai, jaan ka khatra nahi.

clues.label: Buzurg
clues.text: Buzurg ko sahara de ke utaara ja sakta hai. Is se raaste ka mehfooz hona ya na hona nahi badalta.

clues.label: Lift
clues.text: Aag mein lift waise bhi istemal nahi hoti. Hukm seerhiyon ka hai, lift ka nahi.

cases.explain: Officer ne sirf sholon ko khatra samjha. Asal qatil dhuan hai, aur woh seerhiyon mein hi bharta hai - 'aag wahan nahi pohanchi' ka matlab 'mehfooz' nahi. Tang seerhi aur buzurg sirf raftaar kam karte hain.

cases.title: Sailaab ka Faisla
cases.brief: Sailaab mein aap ki kashti mein 6 logon ki jagah hai. Masjid ki pakki chhat pe 20 log hain (paani abhi 6 foot neeche). Ek kache ghar mein 5 log hain (deewaron mein dararein). Ek darakht pe ek jawan hai (rassi se bandha hua). Aap ne kashti pehle kache ghar bheji.
cases.question: Kaunsa usool aap ke faisle ki sab se behtar wazahat karta hai?
options: Pehle un ko bachao jin ka khatra sab se jaldi jaan-lewa banne wala hai.
Pehle wahan jao jahan sab se zyada log phanse hain.
Pehle bachon aur buzurgon ko bachao.
Pehle un ko bachao jin tak pohanchna sab se aasan hai.
cases.answer: Pehle un ko bachao jin ka khatra sab se jaldi jaan-lewa banne wala hai.

clues.label: Waqt ka hisaab
clues.text: Engineer ka andaza: kacha ghar ghante bhar mein gir sakta hai. Masjid aur darakht kal tak mehfooz hain.

clues.label: Logon ki ginti
clues.text: Sab se zyada log masjid pe hain. Is usool pe chalte toh kashti masjid jati, kache ghar nahi.

clues.label: Bachay aur buzurg
clues.text: Masjid ki chhat pe bhi 7 bachay aur kai buzurg hain. Yeh usool kache ghar ko masjid pe tarjeeh nahi deta.

clues.label: Raasta
clues.text: Sab se qareeb darakht wala jawan hai. Is usool pe chalte toh kashti pehle wahan jati.

cases.explain: Faisla 'kaun pehle doobega' pe tha: kacha ghar girne wala hai, baqi dono abhi mehfooz hain. Ginti ka usool masjid bhejta, aasani ka usool darakht pe - sirf 'sab se foori khatra' wala usool is faisle se mel khata hai.

cases.title: Do Chaabiyon ki Tijori
cases.brief: Bank ki tijori sirf tab khulti hai jab do chaabiyan ek saath lagein: ek manager ki, ek cashier ki. Kal raat tijori khuli aur 50 lakh ghaib ho gaye; taala toota nahi. Manager: 'Meri chaabi poori raat meri jeb mein thi.'
cases.question: Agar manager sach bol raha hai, toh kaunsi baat zaroor sach hai?
options: Ya toh manager khud tijori pe maujood tha, ya us ki chaabi ki naqal ban chuki hai.
Manager ki chaabi ki naqal zaroor ban chuki hai.
Chori cashier ne ki, kyunke doosri chaabi usi ke paas thi.
Chori mein kam az kam do log shamil the.
cases.answer: Ya toh manager khud tijori pe maujood tha, ya us ki chaabi ki naqal ban chuki hai.

clues.label: Manager ki chaabi
clues.text: Tijori manager wali chaabi ke baghair khul hi nahi sakti. Chaabi jeb mein thi - toh ya jeb wala wahan tha, ya koi doosri waisi chaabi.

clues.label: Naqal ka imkaan
clues.text: Naqal ek imkaan hai, yaqeen nahi. Yeh bhi mumkin hai ke manager khud apni chaabi le ke tijori pe gaya ho.

clues.label: Cashier ki chaabi
clues.text: Cashier ki chaabi chori ya naqal bhi ho sakti hai. Sirf chaabi ka us ke naam hona usay chor nahi banata.

clues.label: Kitne chor
clues.text: Do chaabiyan chahiyen, do aadmi nahi. Ek hi shakhs dono chaabiyan (ya un ki naqal) laga sakta hai.

cases.explain: Tijori ke liye manager ki chaabi (ya us ki naqal) lazmi hai. Asli chaabi jeb mein thi - toh ya jeb wala khud wahan tha ya naqal bani. 'Naqal zaroor bani' ek imkaan ko yaqeen bana deta hai; yehi is sawal ka jaal hai.

cases.title: ATM ka Daawa
cases.brief: Gahak: 'Mera ATM card kal raat 9 baje Karachi mein chori hua aur 9:30 pe chor ne 50,000 nikal liye.' Record: paise 9:30 pe Lahore ke ATM se nikle aur PIN pehli koshish mein sahi laga. Clerk: 'Daawa jhoota hai - aadhe ghante mein card Karachi se Lahore nahi pohanch sakta.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat clerk ke nateeje ko sab se zyada kamzor karti hai?
options: Card ka data aur PIN copy kar ke kisi bhi sheher mein naqli card banaya ja sakta hai.
Gahak 10 saal se bank ka customer hai aur kabhi koi shikayat nahi ki.
Gahak ne chori ki report police mein bhi darj karwayi hai.
Lahore ke us ATM ka camera us raat kharab tha.
cases.answer: Card ka data aur PIN copy kar ke kisi bhi sheher mein naqli card banaya ja sakta hai.

clues.label: Card ki copy
clues.text: Bank ki security team: is mahine 'skimming' ke kai case aaye - asli card jeb mein rehta hai aur us ki naqal doosre sheher mein chalti hai.

clues.label: Gahak ka record
clues.text: Achha record achhi baat hai, magar yeh nahi batata ke card aadhe ghante mein Lahore kaise pohancha.

clues.label: Police report
clues.text: Report toh jhoota daawa karne wala bhi likhwa sakta hai. Is se clerk ki 'faasle' wali daleel nahi toot'ti.

clues.label: ATM ka camera
clues.text: Camera na hone se sirf yeh hua ke tasveer nahi mili. Is se na daawa sabit hota hai na ghalat.

cases.explain: Clerk ne maan liya ke paise nikalne ke liye asli card ka Lahore pohanchna zaroori hai. Agar card ki naqal ban sakti hai toh yeh buniyad hi khatam. Achha record aur police report gahak ko shareef dikhate hain, daleel ko nahi torte.

cases.title: Viral Tasveer
cases.brief: WhatsApp pe tasveer viral hai: 'Aaj Karachi mein barf bari!' Aap ka reporter: 'Tasveer asli hai. Main ne maahir se check karwaya - is mein koi editing nahi hui. Fauran chhaap dete hain.'
cases.question: Chhaapne se pehle kaunsa sawal poochhna sab se zaroori hai?
options: Yeh tasveer kab aur kahan kheenchi gayi thi?
Tasveer bhejne wala shakhs bharose ke qabil hai ya nahi?
Kya doosre akhbaar bhi yeh tasveer chhaap rahe hain?
Tasveer kis mobile ya camera se kheenchi gayi?
cases.answer: Yeh tasveer kab aur kahan kheenchi gayi thi?

clues.label: Tasveer ki tareekh
clues.text: Internet pe talaash ki toh yehi tasveer 2016 mein bhi mili - Murree ke naam se.

clues.label: Bhejne wala
clues.text: Bhejne wale shareef aadmi hain - unhein bhi kisi group se aayi thi. Imandaar log bhi purani tasveer aage barha dete hain.

clues.label: Doosre akhbaar
clues.text: Do website chhaap chuki hain. Magar ghalat khabar sab mil ke chhaapein tab bhi ghalat hi rehti hai.

clues.label: Camera
clues.text: Camera ka model jaan ke yeh pata nahi chalta ke manzar Karachi ka hai ya aaj ka.

cases.explain: 'Editing nahi hui' ka matlab sirf itna hai ke tasveer asli hai - yeh nahi ke woh aaj ki aur Karachi ki hai. Purani asli tasveer bhi jhooti khabar ban sakti hai. Bhejne wale ka imandaar hona is khatre ko nahi rokta.

cases.title: Ice Cream aur Doobna
cases.brief: Reporter ki khabar: 'Sheher ke jin mahinon mein ice cream zyada bikti hai, unhi mahinon mein doobne ke waqiaat bhi zyada hote hain. Sabit hua ke ice cream khane se doobne ka khatra barh jata hai.'
cases.question: Is daleel mein sab se bari ghalti kya hai?
options: Dono garmi ki wajah se barhte hain: log ice cream bhi zyada khate hain, nahate bhi zyada.
Reporter ne sirf ek hi sheher ka data dekha hai.
Bohat se log ice cream khaye baghair bhi doob jate hain.
Reporter ne ice cream bechne walon se baat nahi ki.
cases.answer: Dono garmi ki wajah se barhte hain: log ice cream bhi zyada khate hain, nahate bhi zyada.

clues.label: Garmi ke mahine
clues.text: Data: ice cream aur doobne ke waqiaat dono May se August mein barhte hain - jab log samandar aur nehron pe jate hain.

clues.label: Ek sheher ka data
clues.text: Doosre sheheron mein bhi yehi dono cheezein saath barhti hain. Zyada data se ghalti door nahi hoti.

clues.label: Baghair ice cream
clues.text: Kuch misaalein 'khatra barhta hai' wale daawe ko ghalat sabit nahi kartin - khatra barhna har ek pe laagu nahi hota.

clues.label: Dukaandaron ki raaye
clues.text: Dukaandaron ki raaye se sirf bikri ki tasdeeq hoti - jo pehle hi maloom hai.

cases.explain: Do cheezon ka saath barhna yeh sabit nahi karta ke ek doosri ki wajah hai - yahan dono ki wajah teesri cheez hai: garmi. 'Sirf ek sheher' wali baat sahi lagti hai, magar sau sheheron ka data bhi yehi ghalti dohrata.

cases.title: Mukhbir ki Ittila
cases.brief: Mukhbir: 'Sone wale musafir ne apna ticket naqd khareeda hai, aur woh Dubai se aaya hai.' Record: Rafiq - Dubai se aaya, ticket card se liya. Usman - Doha se aaya, ticket naqd liya. Mrs. Khan - Dubai se aayin, ticket ka record nahi mila.
cases.question: Agar mukhbir ki dono baatein sach hain, toh kaunsa nateeja durust hai?
options: Sona Mrs. Khan ke paas hai, aur unhon ne ticket naqd khareeda tha.
Sona Usman ke paas hai, kyunke record mein sirf usi ne naqd ticket liya.
Sona Rafiq ya Mrs. Khan mein se kisi ke paas hai - dono Dubai se aaye.
Mukhbir ki ittila ghalat hai, kyunke naqd ticket wala Doha se aaya.
cases.answer: Sona Mrs. Khan ke paas hai, aur unhon ne ticket naqd khareeda tha.

clues.label: Mrs. Khan ka ticket
clues.text: Travel agent ka register mila: Mrs. Khan ka ticket naqd raqam de ke liya gaya tha.

clues.label: Usman ka safar
clues.text: Usman ka passport: woh Doha se seedha aaya, Dubai gaya hi nahi. Mukhbir ki doosri baat us pe poori nahi utarti.

clues.label: Rafiq ka ticket
clues.text: Rafiq ke ticket ki raseed pe us ke bank card ka number chhapa hai - naqd nahi.

clues.label: Ittila ki sachai
clues.text: Yeh mukhbir pichle 5 case mein har dafa sahi nikla. Aur sawal ne maan liya hai ke dono baatein sach hain.

cases.explain: Dono shartein ek saath: naqd ticket AUR Dubai. Rafiq ne card diya, Usman Doha se aaya - dono bahar. Bachi Mrs. Khan, toh un ka ticket naqd hi hoga. 'Sirf Usman ne naqd liya' wala jawab bhool jata hai ke Mrs. Khan ka record mila hi nahi.

cases.title: Kelon ka Container
cases.brief: Container ke kaghzaat: '18 ton kele'. Kaante pe wazan 26 ton nikla. Maalik: 'Farq barf ka hai. Kelon ko thanda rakhne ke liye 8 ton barf rakhi gayi thi, aur barf ka wazan kaghzaat mein nahi likha jata.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat maalik ki wazahat ko sab se zyada kamzor karti hai?
options: Container ka fridge 20 din se band hai, andar 35 degree - barf kab ki pighal ke beh chuki hoti.
Maalik pehle bhi ek dafa ghalat kaghzaat pe jurmana bhar chuka hai.
Usi jahaz ke doosre kele walon ne barf nahi rakhi thi.
8 ton barf khareedna aur rakhna bohat mehnga parta hai.
cases.answer: Container ka fridge 20 din se band hai, andar 35 degree - barf kab ki pighal ke beh chuki hoti.

clues.label: Fridge ka record
clues.text: Container ka apna meter: fridge safar ke pehle din hi band ho gaya tha. Farsh pe paani nikalne ke suraakh khule hain.

clues.label: Maalik ka maazi
clues.text: Purana jurmana shak paida karta hai, magar yeh nahi batata ke aaj ki wazahat ghalat hai.

clues.label: Doosre container
clues.text: Doosre container naye hain, un ke fridge theek the - unhein barf ki zaroorat hi nahi thi.

clues.label: Barf ka kharcha
clues.text: Mehnga hona namumkin hona nahi. Qeemti maal bachane ke liye taajir kharcha kar lete hain.

cases.explain: 35 degree mein 20 din baad barf baqi nahi reh sakti, toh 8 ton ka farq barf nahi ho sakta. Purana jurmana aur doosron ka barf na rakhna sirf shak barhate hain - wazahat ko seedha nahi torte.

cases.title: Akbari Sikka
cases.brief: Ek sahab 'Akbar badshah ke daur ka sikka' bechne aaye hain. Daleel: 'Is ki chandi ka test hua hai - 96% khalis nikli, bilkul waisi jaisi Akbar ke sikkon mein hoti thi. Is liye sikka asli hai.'
cases.question: Is daleel mein sab se bari kamzori kya hai?
options: Khalis chandi aaj bhi milti hai; is se yeh pata nahi chalta ke sikka kab dhala.
Chandi ka test sirf ek hi lab ne kiya hai.
Bechne wala khud purane sikkon ka maahir nahi hai.
Akbar ke kuch sikkon mein chandi 96% se kam bhi hoti thi.
cases.answer: Khalis chandi aaj bhi milti hai; is se yeh pata nahi chalta ke sikka kab dhala.

clues.label: Chandi aur zamana
clues.text: Sunar ne bataya: 96% khalis chandi aaj bazaar mein aam milti hai, aur naqli sikke isi se banaye jate hain.

clues.label: Lab ka test
clues.text: Doosri lab ne bhi 96% hi bataya. Test sahi hai - masla test mein nahi, us se nikale gaye nateeje mein hai.

clues.label: Bechne wala
clues.text: Bechne wale ka maahir hona zaroori nahi - daleel test pe khari hai, us ki maharat pe nahi.

clues.label: Akbar ke sikke
clues.text: Museum ke asli Akbari sikkon mein chandi 94 se 97% tak hai - 96% us daire ke andar hi hai.

cases.explain: Test sirf yeh batata hai ke chandi khalis hai - yeh nahi ke sikka 450 saal purana hai. Wohi chandi aaj bhi dhaali ja sakti hai. Doosri lab se bhi yehi nateeja aata, is liye 'ek lab' asal kamzori nahi.

cases.title: Darbar ki Tasveer
cases.brief: Ek painting pesh hui: 'Mughal darbar, san 1650'. Lab ki report: aasman mein jo neela rang hai woh 'Prussian blue' hai, jo 1704 mein ijaad hua. Baqi tamam rang wohi hain jo 1650 mein istemal hote the.
cases.question: In haqaiq se kaunsa nateeja sab se mazboot hai?
options: Kam az kam aasman ka hissa 1704 ke baad ranga gaya - marammat ho ya naqal.
Poori painting 1704 ke baad ki bani hui naqal hai.
Painting asli hai; aasman baad mein kisi ne marammat mein theek kiya.
Lab ka test ghalat hai, kyunke baqi sab rang purane hain.
cases.answer: Kam az kam aasman ka hissa 1704 ke baad ranga gaya - marammat ho ya naqal.

clues.label: Neela rang
clues.text: Prussian blue 1704 se pehle duniya mein tha hi nahi. Jahan yeh rang hai, woh hissa us ke baad hi ranga gaya.

clues.label: Baqi rang
clues.text: Baqi rang purane tareeqe ke hain. Naqal banane wala bhi purane rang istemal kar sakta hai - aur asli painting mein bhi yehi hote.

clues.label: Marammat ka record
clues.text: Painting ki marammat ka koi record nahi mila - na hone ka, na na hone ka.

clues.label: Lab ki sehat
clues.text: Lab ne test teen dafa dohraya - har dafa wohi nateeja. Purane rangon ka hona neele rang ko purana nahi banata.

cases.explain: Haqaiq sirf itna pakka batate hain ke aasman 1704 ke baad ranga gaya. Poori painting naqal hai ya sirf marammat hui - dono mumkin hain, is liye dono 'pakke' jawab haqaiq se aage nikal jate hain. Sab se mazboot nateeja wohi jo utna hi kahe jitna sabit hai.
